Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 2C19. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN. Join compound_records to activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Join docs to activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Filter by target name 'Cytochrome P450 2C19' and target organism 'Homo sapiens'. Filter by standard_type 'IC50' and standard_relation '='. Require pubmed_id or doi to be present. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not use DISTINCT; preserve all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
